purpose: Teach: カマ/ぽん/はいっ/よれ/たがら/辰/くろ/うぅ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、調理実習のカマ係だろ
lines.en: Hey Riku — you got stuck with kiln duty for cooking class, right?
lines.style: Casual, direct jab delivered with a slight grin. Leans forward just enough to establish she's testing him. Light, expectant tone — waiting to see how he'll react.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ぼくの肩、ぽんと叩いたな、桜
lines.en: You just tapped my shoulder like that, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, caught-you delivery. Voice level but with a wry edge underneath. Not accusatory — more like he's filing it away as evidence of her teasing. Slight amusement lurking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、教室にはいって来た時、皆おどろいたぜ
lines.en: When you walked into the classroom, everyone actually noticed, you know.
lines.style: Softer observation. Steady pace, almost thoughtful. Not mocking — genuine recognition of how he landed in the room. Slight warmth, like she's noticing something about him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、シャツがよれてんぜ、桜
lines.en: Your shirt's all wrinkled, isn't it.
lines.style: Light ribbing, matter-of-fact. Quick delivery with a knowing smirk in the voice. Teasing without sting — the kind of comment that invites him to defend himself or admit it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、給食食べたがらないだろ
lines.en: You don't really want to eat the school lunch, do you.
lines.style: Knowing, direct question masked as statement. Slight side-eye in the tone. Not accusatory — more like she's caught onto something he hasn't admitted yet.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、辰年生まれの父さん、おだやかだな、桜
lines.en: Your dad's born in the year of the dragon — he's pretty calm about things.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost conversational tangent. Steady, thoughtful pace. Recognition without explanation. She's noticing something true about him through his father.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のくろいパーカー、お洒落だぜ
lines.en: That black hoodie of yours actually looks pretty good, you know.
lines.style: Genuine compliment, offered lightly but without irony. Brief pause before delivery, like she's allowing herself to say something sincere. Warm underneath the casual tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、うぅって声、聞こえてんぞ、桜
lines.en: I can hear that little sound you make — that 'uh' — you can't hide it, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle tease, close and knowing. Voice softened, intimate without being intense. Catching her in something small and real. Slight smile underneath the words.
